newsitem.title: USA: Dow rallies to end higher; fourth biggest weekly loss.
newsitem.headline: Dow rallies to end higher; fourth biggest weekly loss.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed higher Friday after a tumultuous week that produced the fourth biggest weekly loss ever as speculation was rife that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates again to slow the economy's growth.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended 48.72 points higher at 6,526.07, but for the week, it dropped 214.52 points -- the fourth largest after Oct. 13, 1989's fall of 216.26.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 540 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
